payout_value_note: $25 to the referring member per referred account. The referred friend gets their first $5 deposited. No limit on referrals.
payout_quote: Refer a friend, family member or coworker to Allegany First FCU and when your referred person opens an account with us we will deposit their first $5 into their account and we'll deposit $25 into your account!** ... There's no limit to how many people you can refer.
steps: Member refers a friend, family member, or coworker to Allegany First FCU.
Referred person opens an account with the credit union.
The referred person gets their first $5 deposited into their account.
$25 deposited into the referring member's account once the referred member's account has been open for 90 days.
catches: No limit on referrals — but only $25 per referral and the friend only needs to open an account.
The $25 is deposited only after the referred account has been open for 90 days.
The friend's reward is just their first $5 — small.
Thin terms on the page (single-paragraph program description).
biggest_catch: Only $25 per referral, and it's not deposited until the friend's account has been open for 90 days.
eligibility: Allegany First FCU membership; referred person must open an account.
timing: Referral ~5 min active; $25 paid 90 days after the referred account opens.
